steps.output:
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_dividers = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_dividers = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    r_bounds = [-1] + row_dividers + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + col_dividers + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(r_bounds) - 1):
        row_out = []
        for ci in range(len(c_bounds) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c]
                     for r in range(r_bounds[ri] + 1, r_bounds[ri + 1])
                     for c in range(c_bounds[ci] + 1, c_bounds[ci + 1])]
            marks = sum(v != bg for v in cells)
            row_out.append(1 if marks == 2 else bg)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
